title: Export Fidelity Checker
description: Given an exported xlsx/csv/pdf/xbrl/vc rendering and the canonical OCG v0.4 receipt it claims to come from, extracts the export's embedded binding (tool_id/execution_hash/chaingraph_version/compute_mode/keyid) and compares it field-by-field to the receipt, then deterministically re-renders the export from the receipt using the same shipped exporter and byte-compares. Also reports the receipt's §23 input_attestations (pointer resolution + digest binding). Zero network calls anywhere in the tool.

receipt.description: Canonical OCG v0.4 artifact JSON the export claims to come from

export_bytes_base64.description: Base64 of the exported artifact file (xlsx/csv/pdf/xbrl/vc.json) to check

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_export_fidelity
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compares an exported chaingraph_export rendering (xlsx/csv/pdf/xbrl/vc) against the canonical OCG receipt it claims to come from: embedded-binding field compare plus byte-identical deterministic re-render.
